metadata.title: Sitecore.Automation.Framework
metadata.description: ---WARNING: This extension is still under active development and used internally by the FFW Sitecore team. Please, contact the author before start using it.--- Sitecore Automation Framework (SAF) is a PowerShell module built to support Sitecore DevOps in their daily work. It is designed to optimize the installation and maintenance of all Sitecore 9 and upper components – Sitecore Experience Manager, Sitecore Experience Platform and Sitecore Experience Commerce.

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Remove-Database' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
